# `AutoOpenDevice`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Notification that the automatic reconnect logic reopened a device.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyDeviceReopen @0x122790 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) to all retained sockets after a successful automatic reopen by the reconnect logic. Family: custom; no state or error. APK consumer: none established.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AutoOpenDevice"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `device` | string | yes | - | Reopened device identifier. [READ] |
| `type` | string | yes | - | Device type supplied by the reconnect code; vocabulary not established. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, reopened - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"AutoOpenDevice","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","device":"Example focuser","type":"focuser"}
```
